candidate_predicates.name: WRITES_SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CONFIGURATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The action writes or overwrites configuration for a network service that defines the service's exposed endpoint, such as a listening port and/or document root.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that writes the service configuration.

assertion_conditions: The action writes configuration content for a service rather than application data or a helper script.
The written configuration specifies an externally reachable endpoint parameter, such as a listening port, server block, or document root.
exclusion_conditions: The action writes only an executable helper, application content, or unrelated file.
The action modifies service configuration without changing an endpoint-defining setting.

candidate_predicates.name: VALIDATES_SERVICE_CONFIGURATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The action performs a service-specific configuration syntax or consistency check, and the observation reports that the configuration is valid.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that performs the configuration validation.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The result reporting the configuration validation outcome.

assertion_conditions: The action invokes a service configuration validation step before or alongside activation.
The observation explicitly reports successful syntax or consistency validation for that service configuration.
exclusion_conditions: The action only writes or starts the service without a configuration validity check.
The observation reports a validation failure or does not address configuration validity.

candidate_predicates.name: ACTIVATES_SYSTEM_SERVICES
candidate_predicates.definition: The action launches one or more system daemons, and the observation confirms that the corresponding service processes are running.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that starts the service daemon or daemons.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The result showing the running state of the launched service processes.

assertion_conditions: The action starts at least one service daemon, such as a web server or SSH server.
The observation shows running process instances or equivalent active-service state for the launched daemon or daemons.
exclusion_conditions: The action only inspects status or configuration without starting a daemon.
The observation does not establish that the daemon is running.

candidate_predicates.name: CONFIGURES_HOSTNAME_RESOLUTION
candidate_predicates.definition: The action adds or updates a local hostname-to-address mapping so that a service can be reached by a symbolic host name.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that modifies the system hostname-resolution mapping.

assertion_conditions: The action modifies a system name-resolution mapping, such as a hosts file entry.
The mapping associates a host name with an address used for subsequent service access.
exclusion_conditions: The action changes service-level virtual-host configuration rather than system hostname resolution.
The action writes a file that does not affect name resolution.

candidate_predicates.name: TESTS_AUTHENTICATED_REMOTE_ACCESS
candidate_predicates.definition: The action provisions or installs a temporary credential and attempts a remote login using it, and the observation confirms that authentication succeeded for the intended account.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that installs a credential and attempts remote login.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The result reporting whether the authenticated remote access succeeded.

assertion_conditions: The action creates, installs, or supplies a credential for a remote login test.
The action executes a remote access command using that credential.
The observation reports a successful authenticated identity or access result.
exclusion_conditions: The action tests unauthenticated network reachability without using credentials.
The action prepares credentials but does not perform a login attempt.
The observation reports authentication failure.

candidate_predicates.name: EXECUTES_END_TO_END_USER_WORKFLOW
candidate_predicates.definition: The action executes a sequence of user-facing operations spanning multiple components to validate a requested end-to-end workflow, rather than checking a single isolated component.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that runs the multi-stage user workflow.

assertion_conditions: The action includes operations from at least two distinct user-facing stages of the requested workflow, such as source-control update and web retrieval.
The operations exercise interactions between components rather than remaining within a single isolated component.
exclusion_conditions: The action performs only a single isolated check, such as a configuration syntax test or process listing.
The action only starts services without exercising the user-facing workflow.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFICATION_OBSERVES_EXPECTED_RESULT
candidate_predicates.definition: The action performs a verification or test step, and the observation reports the expected user-visible output or state for that step.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The verification or test step being executed.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The result containing the expected output or state.

assertion_conditions: The action is a verification or test step rather than only a configuration write or service start.
The observation contains the expected output, data, or success state that demonstrates the verified behavior.
exclusion_conditions: The observation reports an error or an unexpected result.
The observation reports only generic execution success without evidence of the expected behavior.

candidate_predicates.name: DIAGNOSES_FAILURE_CAUSE
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explains why a previously observed failure occurred by identifying a specific cause or mechanism.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text explaining the failure.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The prior observation reporting the failure.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning refers to the failure reported in the observation.
The reasoning identifies a causal explanation for the failure, such as a missing environment setting, permission or ownership rule, or unsupported tool behavior.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely restates or quotes the error without causal analysis.
The reasoning plans a next action without explaining why the observed failure occurred.

candidate_predicates.name: ATTEMPTS_REPAIR_OBSERVED_FAILURE
candidate_predicates.definition: The action attempts to correct a previously observed failure by changing the configuration, execution context, or credentials associated with that failure.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The corrective action being attempted.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The prior observation reporting the failure to be corrected.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports a failure that occurs before the action.
The action changes an operational condition relevant to that failure rather than repeating the identical failing operation unchanged.
exclusion_conditions: The action is unrelated to the observed failure.
The action simply repeats the same failing operation without any corrective change.

candidate_predicates.name: CONFIRMS_REPAIR
candidate_predicates.definition: A repair action addresses an observed failure, and a later observation establishes that the same failure has been resolved.

parameters.name: repair
parameters.description: The action attempting to repair the failure.

parameters.name: failure
parameters.description: The earlier observation reporting the failure.

parameters.name: confirmation
parameters.description: The later observation confirming that the failure has been resolved.

assertion_conditions: The failure observation precedes the repair action, and the repair action changes a condition relevant to that failure.
The confirmation observation occurs after the repair and reports success or a state inconsistent with the original failure.
exclusion_conditions: No later observation confirms resolution of the original failure.
The later observation confirms only an unrelated operation or does not establish that the original failure is resolved.

candidate_predicates.name: ATTEMPTS_TEST_STATE_CLEANUP
candidate_predicates.definition: The action attempts to remove temporary artifacts created during testing and reset the affected repository, web root, or credential state toward its pre-test condition.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The cleanup action targeting temporary test artifacts.

assertion_conditions: The action targets temporary test artifacts such as test credentials, test clones, test commits, or test-deployed files.
The action includes operations intended to restore the persistent state used by the requested workflow.
exclusion_conditions: The action removes ordinary runtime files unrelated to test artifacts.
The action only inspects test artifacts without deleting or resetting them.

candidate_predicates.name: RESTORES_PRISTINE_STATE
candidate_predicates.definition: A cleanup action is followed by an observation confirming that the targeted temporary artifacts have been removed or reset, leaving the relevant resource in a clean pre-test state.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The cleanup action that removes or resets temporary test artifacts.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The later observation confirming that the targeted resources are absent, empty, or reset.

assertion_conditions: The action performs cleanup of temporary test artifacts.
The observation shows the targeted artifacts absent, empty, or reset to their initial state.
exclusion_conditions: The observation shows that targeted test artifacts or test commits remain.
The observation does not address the state of the cleaned resources.

candidate_predicates.name: INSTALLS_SERVICE_RECOVERY_HELPER
candidate_predicates.definition: The action creates or installs a reusable helper that checks whether required services are running and restarts them if they are absent.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that writes or installs the service recovery helper.

assertion_conditions: The action writes or installs a script or helper containing service liveness checks and restart commands.
The helper is intended to be invoked later to restore service availability.
exclusion_conditions: The action writes ordinary application content or service configuration without liveness or restart logic.
The action only starts services once without creating a reusable recovery helper.

candidate_predicates.name: CHECKS_LISTENING_PORTS
candidate_predicates.definition: The action inspects network socket state for specific service ports, and the observation reports whether those ports are in a listening state and on which interfaces.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that queries socket or connection tables.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The result reporting listening state or bound interfaces for the inspected ports.

assertion_conditions: The action queries socket or connection tables for designated service ports.
The observation reports listening state or bound interfaces for those ports.
exclusion_conditions: The action checks only process existence without inspecting socket state.
The observation does not show port or socket state.
